'''Tatrang''' was the [[Star/Legends|star]] of the [[Tatrang system]],<ref name="PoG2" /> located in the [[Tammuz sector/Legends|Tammuz sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> It was a [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]].<ref name="PoG2" />
